# Buttons

Buttons trigger actions. They are the primary mechanism for users to submit
forms, confirm choices, and initiate processes.

## When to use

- Use buttons for actions, not navigation. For navigation, use links.
- Use a primary button for the main action on a page or modal.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Create report | Report |
| Delete dataset | Delete |

## Terminology

| Term or term pair | Usage |
|---|---|
| Cancel vs Close | Use Cancel to back out of a form; Close for read-only screens. |
